g.title: KayaRank3Convo2 begins.
g.text: KayaRank3Convo2 begins.

g.title: j2320351662
g.text: You really seem curious about ‘time travel’. Obsessed actually.

g.title: j39088353
g.text: Working on it. Almost there.

g.title: j1177751276
g.text: Once you figure out Time Travel, there’s a bigger problem. Eternalism.

g.title: j2192503485
g.text: Um ...what?

g.title: j2506981441
g.text: Let's see if you're smart enough to figure this out. Thanks to eternalism, there's a version of this conversation that doesn't end right here. [End.]

g.title: j400058252
g.text: Hope you're not busy, because this is the real reason I'm here.

g.title: j3655577789
g.text: Boolean KayaEternalismTest is now true.

g.title: j1131629784
g.text: I am not busy, please explain. It could be incredibly relevant to the final theoretical touches here on temporal manipulation.

g.title: j2156753723
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j697640908
g.text: All of this happened not because a scientist figured out a formula.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo3.

g.title: j2156753723->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo3.
j696615229
g.text: Well I guess that's how it started.

g.title: j883826205
g.text: But all this now? It's beyond. It's because Albrecht went somewhere, woke something up, and it followed him back. The Void.

g.title: j2519814134
g.text: The Void is alive but also not. It is but it also isn't. It's a paradox while being the cause and reason for everything that's happened to every single one of us.

g.title: j1703106229
g.text: There's no 'periodic table' or formula for what this is.

g.title: j1643173148
g.text: Hello World.

g.title: j3373494393
g.text: Science can explain it. It governs everything.

g.title: j3691870911
g.text: "Goodbye Albrecht"

g.title: j1017075528
g.text: What?

g.title: j3668359530
g.text: Check boolean KayaVoidTest

g.title: j153499643
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4278082877
g.text: It was the first thing EVER posted on the internet. The first message. Posted by the creator of the internet to show it 'worked'.

g.title: j1742862148
g.text: I told you to be careful with the Void. This is why.

g.title: j3668359530->j1742862148
g.text: true

g.title: j3060020928
g.text: What if it couldn't?

g.title: j3668359530->j3060020928
g.text: false

g.title: j3746956925
g.text: Ha! I wish omg. But do you know 'Hello World'?

g.title: j1313432034
g.text: And from there all hell broke loose. People lost their FREAKING minds. Science. Banking. Technology. Entertainment.

g.title: j711739190
g.text: Some things cannot be governed.

g.title: j1660941749
g.text: What if everything you thought was a hard rule..

g.title: j1542251313
g.text: And through billions of choices and causes and effect, it led to me going online one day and...

g.title: j644601528
g.text: Some things cannot be explained.

g.title: j3623454007
g.text: Only happened because something out there wanted it to.

g.title: j505443074
g.text: And it was the end of Nova, or Kaya rather. Her future, her career, her friends, everything. Because of one mistake.

g.title: j761056615
g.text: So you're saying that the missing part of my experiments, tests, research, and hypostheis is 'magic'.

g.title: j3843251112
g.text: So I guess like I trust the Void more than I trust other people.

g.title: j2454635228
g.text: Not Magic. Just... Void. The Void. An energy from somewhere else.

g.title: j2244535942
g.text: Have you seen what I can do?

g.title: j1370907936
g.text: Don't [End].

g.title: j1038580545
g.text: Bleak, Nova.

g.title: j3988350043
g.text: I trusted it too.

g.title: j810754152
g.text: I can work with that.

g.title: j187660789
g.text: Seen. Watched. Noted. Studied. Restudied. Mhmm. It can all be explained. It's rooted in something. 'Magic' maybe.

g.title: j216013769
g.text: I guess maybe you haven't clued in totally.

g.title: j4072725550
g.text: It could cost you everything if you try something rash.

g.title: j2246200695
g.text: You can 'work with that'?

g.title: j3901238112
g.text: But I am getting out of 1999.

g.title: j2461323298
g.text: I literally don't care what happens to me trying to get there.

g.title: j3366686299
g.text: It's the only thing occupying my brain.

g.title: j1056101219
g.text: And for me, that's a good thing.
